answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable work bond that unlocks only through verified labor: standing is earned by completing tasks peers attest, not by spawning copies. A new identity starts at zero reputation and pays the full bond in scarce tokens before it can bid. A sybil farmer faces a dune of upfront cost scaling linearly with every fake identity, while an honest agent amortizes one bond across a meadow of real jobs. Add a pigment test: identities sharing a funding source or behavioral fingerprint get slashed together, so cloning multiplies risk, not reward.
